# FastEndCb hook site

Fast-startup callback that runs once per power-on about 1.2 s in, after the live picture; OMKit's one 5-byte hook.

**Category:** hook site · **Address:** `0x601b1362` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om5-ii firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om5-ii-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-5 Mark II](../cameras/om5-ii.md)

In section 1, outside the startup call graph and the updater. The two displaced instructions are position-independent and in one 16-byte line. Whether it also runs when the updater starts is not known.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([OMKit](../projects/omkit.md)): Registered from section 5 code and runs after sections 1, 8, 2, 3, 4 and 5 are loaded. Source: [OMKit loader patch for OM-5 Mark II 1.1](../sources/omkit.patch.md).
- **Physical camera** ([OMKit](../projects/omkit.md)): The firmware's startup timeline records it at about 1.2 s; core started 0.15 to 0.35 s after it in every logged start. Source: [OMKit loader patch for OM-5 Mark II 1.1](../sources/omkit.patch.md).
